materials.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: transparent full-body game character cutout, a single fictional early elderly white man, slightly worn-out and weary, thinning gray hair and gray stubble, ordinary slightly soft build, wearing a rumpled off-white tank top, faded shorts and worn shoes, with large butterfly wings growing from his back (orange and black natural butterfly wing pattern). Photorealistic live-action photographic appearance, natural daylight, real skin and fabric texture. Full body including shoes and complete wings, front three-quarter view, lightly jogging pose, clear silhouette, centered with margin. Truly transparent background. No text, no logos, no extra people, no ground or scenery. Not a real identifiable person.
materials.editPrompt: Remove the entire dark background from this image. Keep only the full man, all butterfly wings, clothes, shoes and hair unchanged. Output a genuine transparent alpha-channel cutout with no backdrop, no shadow, no dark halo. Preserve the complete character and photorealistic details.
